model: Outback Xplore II 29 Frameset Black Olive
description:
Fun, adventurous, and ready to be ridden far, the Tout Terrain Outback Xplore II 29 is any bikepacker or off-road explorer’s best friend. Already a well-known ally for two-wheeled travel, the latest Outback Xplore is even more capable than its predecessor, with wider tire clearance—for up to 2.6” tires—additional mounting bosses on the top and down tubes, and our tried and tested Pinion-specific steel frame for reliable, maintenance-free shifting in any conditions. Pick between a rigid carbon or soft suspension fork. With the Outback Xplore, every ride will be an adventure.
Outback Xplore II 29 highlights

Pinion-specific steel frame for reliable, maintenance-free shifting
Clearance for 29 x 2.6” tires
Additional mounting bosses on the top and down tubes for bikepacking gear
Pairs with a rigid carbon or suspension fork
Sizes Small, Medium, Large and Xtra Large
Available as frame only or with a Pinion C1.12 / C1.12i drive

Frameset or full custom build
This listing is the frameset in Black Olive. We love a good custom build and offer full custom Outback Xplore II builds as well. Please email sales@tout-terrain.bike for a full custom quote.
